system_title: NOVA Enduring Fashion Principles & Styling Mechanics

principles.name: The Rule of Thirds (Proportion Balancing)
principles.rule: Never divide the human figure into 1:1 equal halves (e.g. a tunic ending right at the knees dividing torso and legs equally). Aim for a 1:2 or 2:1 visual ratio.
principles.application: Pair high-waisted trousers or skirts with a tucked or cropped top to dedicate 1/3 of visual height to the upper torso and 2/3 to the leg line, creating an elongated, elegant silhouette.
principles.failure_mode: Long untucked t-shirt over low-rise baggy jeans cuts height visually and distorts body proportions.

principles.name: Volume Balance (Tight-on-Top / Loose-on-Bottom or Vice-Versa)
principles.rule: Contrast garment volumes to create intentional shape and prevent looking either entirely constricting or shapeless.
principles.application: Combine an oversized, boxy chore jacket or blazer with tailored, straight-leg trousers, or an oversized wide-leg pleated pant with a fitted ribbed knit tank or baby tee.
principles.failure_mode: Skinny jeans paired with a skin-tight muscle tee feels dated; head-to-toe oversized garments without defined shoulder or ankle anchor creates an unkempt tent effect.

principles.name: The Sandwich Rule (Visual Framing)
principles.rule: Coordinate the color or weight of your top layer with your footwear to bookend and anchor the outfit.
principles.application: Wearing a cream knit cardigan with medium-wash blue denim and cream leather sneakers balances color top-and-bottom, making the denim the intentional middle layer.
principles.failure_mode: Wearing bright neon shoes with an all-black top, black pants, and a black coat draws the entire visual weight to the feet.

principles.name: Fabric Texture Dialogue (Material Tension)
principles.rule: Monochrome and tonal outfits succeed or fail based on texture variance. Combine at least two distinct tactile surfaces.
principles.application: Pair smooth poplin cotton with heavy ribbed wool, or matte brushed suede with crisp raw denim, or liquid satin with structured tailoring.
principles.failure_mode: Head-to-toe flat jersey cotton (t-shirt + cotton sweatpants + canvas sneakers) looks like loungewear or sleepwear, lacking sartorial depth.

principles.name: The 60-30-10 Color Harmonization Rule
principles.rule: Distribute outfit colors by visual surface area: 60% dominant base, 30% secondary structure, 10% intentional accent.
principles.application: 60% charcoal grey (wool trousers and overcoat), 30% crisp white (oxford shirt or knit), 10% deep burgundy (leather loafers or silk tie).
principles.failure_mode: Wearing four equal 25% color blocks (e.g. yellow hat, red jacket, green pants, blue shoes) results in clownish color noise.

principles.name: High-Low Contrast (Formal Meets Casual)
principles.rule: Elevate casual wear and soften formal tailoring by pairing one formal item with utilitarian or sporty pieces.
principles.application: A tailored double-breasted navy blazer worn over an optic white heavy-cotton tee, straight-leg vintage denim, and black leather penny loafers.
principles.failure_mode: Pairing a full tuxedo jacket with athletic gym mesh shorts and flip-flops without intermediate bridging garments.

principles.name: Footwear-to-Hemline Architecture
principles.rule: The opening of the trouser leg dictates the acceptable shoe profile.
principles.application: Wide-leg trousers require a shoe with sufficient visual weight (chunky sole loafer, retro basketball sneaker, or pointed boot extending past the hem) to avoid having the feet disappear. Tapered trousers require low-profile shoes with a clean ankle break.
principles.failure_mode: Wearing flimsy low-profile ballet flats under extra-long ultra-wide pooled denim where the hem sweeps the ground.

principles.name: Hardware and Metal Finish Integrity
principles.rule: Maintain unified metal tones across all accessories in an ensemble.
principles.application: If belt buckle is polished brass/gold, watch case, sunglasses wire frame, and bag hardware should be gold or brass tone. If silver, keep all hardware in cool nickel/silver.
principles.failure_mode: Silver hoop earrings, gold chunky necklace, gunmetal belt buckle, and rose gold watch.
